epics.title: Qualifier le moteur, le GPU et les plateformes
blockers: Pinned GPUI lacks a usable external-surface composition entry on Linux and Windows; macOS surface renderer accepts only a specific bi-planar video format. A planned GPUI extension or architecture decision is required.
No native CEF host, tested runtime pin, presentation instrumentation or M1 A/B/C raw baselines exists yet.
Linux Mesa, ARM GPU, macOS and Windows native execution access is not established; sandbox, signing, IME and screen-reader evidence is missing.

source_needs.gpu_entry_points: codebase: inspected exact pinned Cargo checkout
source_needs.cef_api_and_binary_compatibility: docs: deferred until the GPUI plan and native qualification path are resolved

validation.tracker: Equivalent invariants of scripts/validate-task-artifacts.ps1 verified with Python; pwsh unavailable, original script not executed.
validation.diff: Tracked and new-file whitespace checks pass; local documentation links resolve; existing tracked changes limited to bench/README.md.
validation.cargo_gates: Not applicable: no Rust, manifest, lockfile, dependency or application change.
validation.native: NOT_EXECUTED; graphical, CEF, sandbox, platform, M1 and accessibility criteria remain missing.

stories.title: Établir le protocole de mesure et les fixtures
stories.implementation_note: Partial: protocol, nine fixture routes and raw-capture validation implemented. No native baseline archive or graphical fixture proof. Status remains IN_PROGRESS, not IN_REVIEW.

evidence.entry_point: scripts/browser-qualification.mjs:13
evidence.proof: Protocol fixes A/B/C, loads, 1920x1080, 60/120 Hz and percentile calculation. bench/browser/evidence/preflight.json contains local NVIDIA driver inventory. Other machine/driver references missing.

evidence.entry_point: scripts/browser-qualification.mjs:16 -> scripts/browser-qualification/fixtures.mjs:18
evidence.proof: scripts/browser-qualification/qualification.test.mjs:90 exercises every route over HTTP from the real CLI. Native IME/popup/download/WebGL execution is manual and NOT_EXECUTED.

evidence.entry_point: native A/B harnesses not available
evidence.proof: Explicit per-target missing-baseline inventory; no raw M1 baseline claimed.

evidence.entry_point: scripts/browser-qualification.mjs:32
evidence.proof: scripts/browser-qualification/qualification.test.mjs:174 distinguishes CPU kinds and rejects a screen-latency claim on CPU samples; native timestamp collection still missing.

evidence.proof: scripts/browser-qualification/qualification.test.mjs:163 and :192 exercise rejection of timestamps, load changes, missing/tampered traces and unpaired configurations through CLI.
